coverage.assessment: The revision drops the old man's failure and the Trusts' revolutionary energy, weakening 'new type of man' and 'earliest victims'. 'Better reason' already lacked its comparison in the first draft.
Dates, places (Nervi, Nauheim, Paris, Armenonville), the Markoe house and the voyage sequence remain clear. 'He replied' clearly refers to Hay.
The V4 exchange is verbatim. Adams speaks first and Hay replies. 'Each was correct' is kept. Splitting the lines into paragraphs does not blur the speakers.
No cause of death is added. 1938 stays a 'perhaps'. The meteor and thirty-year qualifications survive. The Scott quotation is kept without comment.
The retrospective elegiac distance holds. Hay's death is learned in early July as in the source, with no premature disclosure.
The voyage loses its gallows-light rhythm ('One has done it so often!', death sentence talked of lightly). The ending loses Adams's reflection on the commonplace and the Parisian-vanity irony.
'The umpire' arrives without its basis: neither force had favored him, and the spectators are infuriated. The crown-versus-cross irony about Hay's peacemaking is gone.
The caravan and King dependencies are intact. Partner 009 no longer names the Markoe house, though the I Street house and the 'forty-four years' anchor survive.

strengths: All six verbatim passages survive exactly, including the cylinder image, Constantine, the final exchange and the closing sentence.
The revision restores 'For his dynamic theory of history he cared no more than for the kinetic theory of gas', recovering the self-deprecation the voice profile calls for.
The link between Adams's obscurity and Hay's exposure is kept. So is the short Scott quotation, without editorial comment.
The Russia-delay sentence ('The delay measured precisely the time that Hay had to spare') preserves the chapter's mechanical-measure irony.
summary: The revision is identical to the first draft except in paragraphs 1, 2 and 4. All six verbatim passages, the final exchange, Armenonville, the speculative 1938 and the stop at THE END survive. Paragraph 4 restores the self-deprecating 'kinetic theory of gas' clause, which is a gain. Paragraphs 1 and 2 newly cut two causal supports: why the old type of man needs replacing, and what made the Trusts' victims victims. The first draft had already left 'the umpire' and 'better reason' under-grounded. It had also flattened the voyage's gallows-lightness. None of this is a blocker, but small repairs are warranted.
